setup_registry: setup a new fairseq registry with a name, base class, and required flag for component registration
build_x_from_config: build a registry component instance from a DictConfig, string name, or argparse Namespace config object
register_x_decorator: register a class in a fairseq registry using the register_x decorator with an optional dataclass
merge_dataclass_with_parent: merge a registered dataclass configuration with its parent dataclass defaults using merge_with_parent
populate_dataclass_from_namespace: populate a fairseq dataclass from an argparse Namespace using the populate_dataclass utility function
